paper_title: Supernova axions convert to gamma-rays in magnetic fields of progenitor stars
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on the y-axis of Fig. 1
notes: Paper derives new 95% CL SN1987A exclusion on the axion-photon coupling by adding axion-photon conversion in the progenitor star's magnetic field (conservative 100 G surface dipole), extending the exclusion from ma<1e-10 eV up to ma~1e-1 eV. The only explicit numerical value in the text is the low-mass limit |g_agamma| < 2.6e-12 GeV^-1 (full production + UF Galactic field model), encoded here as a flat bound over the low-mass validity range (ma below ~1e-9 eV where Galactic conversion dominates). The mass-dependent extension to ~1e-1 eV (ALP SN1987A blue region in Fig. 1, degrading above ~5e-5 eV due to conversion-probability suppression) is only shown graphically and could not be extracted numerically. The paper also contains GALAXIS/Fermi-LAT projections for a future Galactic SN and NS mergers (not extracted; the measured SN1987A limit is the primary result). Not a DM haloscope search, so no local DM density assumption. Note the ALP limit assumes loop-induced hadronic couplings; a separate 'KSVZ-like' limit assumes KSVZ coupling ratios. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.6, 34)) | Vision: Traced the lower boundary of the blue 'ALP SN1987A (excl. 95%)' region in Fig. 1 (SMM data, 95% CL).
